index_event: First date on which both a heart failure diagnosis and an end-stage renal disease diagnosis are recorded on the same date (use the first date on which both appear together).
inclusion_criteria: History of heart failure: a diagnosis of heart failure recorded any time prior to or on the index date.
End-stage renal disease: a diagnosis of end-stage renal disease recorded any time prior to or on the index date.
observation_window: No minimum prior observation required. Capture medical history any time before the index date. Follow-up after index: until end of enrollment (end of continuous observation) or death.
cohort_exit: End of continuous observation (end of enrollment) or death.
